Mechanisms of GLP-1RAs regarding the pulmonary inflammation as well as the respiration for airway

Potential mechanisms of GLP-1RAs regarding the pulmonary inflammation as well as the respiration for airway. GLP-1RAs regulate multiple molecular networks, including surfactant proteins (SFTPa1, SFTb, SFTPc), oxidative stress markers (ADMA, HDAC6, α-syn), matrix remodeling factors (MMP-9), and key signaling pathways (MAPK, STAT, ERK/JNK/p38). These actions converge on downstream effectors such as inflammatory mediators and interferon-induced GTPase, collectively contributing to the therapeutic effects in inflammatory airway diseases. Orange arrow: positive regulation, Black arrow: upregulation of inflammatory and cytokine/protein expression. Created with biorender.com
